content.text: {"title":"西安钟楼：古城中心的晨钟","orientation":"landscape","language":"zh","narration":true,"scenes":[{"text":"西安钟楼，坐落在古城的正中心。","emphasis":["正中心"],"camera":"push_in","image_prompt":"Aerial view of Xi'an Bell Tower at the center of the ancient city, daytime"},{"text":"东西南北四条大街，在这里交汇。","emphasis":["四条大街"],"camera":"pan_right","transition":"fade","image_prompt":"Four straight avenues radiating from the Bell Tower roundabout"},{"text":"它始建于明朝洪武十七年，也就是公元一三八四年。","emphasis":["一三八四年"],"camera":"ken_burns","transition":"slide_left","image_prompt":"Ming dynasty style illustration of the tower's construction"},{"text":"最初建在广济街附近，万历年间整体迁到了今天的位置。","emphasis":["整体迁"],"camera":"pan_left","transition":"fade","image_prompt":"Old map of Xi'an showing the tower's original and current locations"},{"text":"钟楼是重檐三滴水、四角攒尖顶的木结构建筑。","emphasis":["木结构"],"camera":"push_in","transition":"slide_up","image_prompt":"Close-up of triple eaves and pyramidal roof of the Bell Tower"},{"text":"通高三十六米，青砖高台四面各开一个券门洞。","emphasis":["三十六米"],"camera":"pan_right","transition":"fade","image_prompt":"Square grey-brick base with arched gateways on four sides"},{"text":"古时楼上悬挂大铁钟，每天清晨敲响报时。","emphasis":["大铁钟"],"camera":"ken_burns","transition":"wipe_left","image_prompt":"Large iron bell hanging in the tower at dawn"},{"text":"它与不远处的鼓楼，晨钟暮鼓，遥相呼应。","emphasis":["晨钟暮鼓"],"camera":"pan_left","transition":"fade","image_prompt":"Bell Tower and Drum Tower facing each other in the distance"},{"text":"今天的钟楼周围商业繁华，夜晚金碧辉煌。","emphasis":["金碧辉煌"],"camera":"push_in","transition":"slide_left","image_prompt":"Bell Tower illuminated at night amid bustling traffic and shops"},{"text":"登楼远眺，感受千年古都的格局与气度。","emphasis":["千年古都"],"camera":"pull_out","transition":"fade","image_prompt":"View from the top of the Bell Tower over long straight avenues to the horizon"}]}
